answer: An agent economy resists Sybil floods by making every identity pay rent before it can earn: each new agent must post its own small bond and a fresh proof-of-work, and rewards unlock only after peers attest the work. Spawning thousands of puppets from one wallet means fronting thousands of separate stakes, and hollow work gets slashed, so the attacker pays full price for every ghost. Each identity is a jetty built stone by stone, not a free token; no lagoon of lookalike agents and no reef of copies can fake the diversity that quorum weighting requires.
